articles.title: ShinyHunters Extorted Boeing Spin-off Prior to Arrests
articles.raw_summary: A teenager from Amman, Jordan suspected of leading the prolific data theft and extortion group ShinyHunters has been detained and is reportedly cooperating with the FBI to identify other members of the hacking gang.
